name: @funcd/example-env-echo
description: A funcd config+secret example (ADR-0093/0057): a void-input function that echoes the env injected by its bindings — spec.config (a ConfigMap) and spec.secrets (a Secret) — proving both reach the running handler (and the Secret wins a key present in both). Authored in TypeScript against @funcd/shim-nodejs; the contract build generates the JSON Schema from FuncInput/FuncOutput, bakes an eval-free validator, and emits env-echo.mjs + the schema file.
